messages:
maya: Shoreline underpass at 4th & Pine is flooded — Muni 7 is being rerouted, shuttle apparently on hold. Anyone stuck or found a dry detour?

jamie: Yikes. I'm walking around 5th, muddy but moving. No service alerts on 511, weird.

eli: Stuck on inbound 280 due to stalled truck, switching to bike. Does anyone have an umbrella stash near the office?

rachel: @maya TY for heads-up. I left a spare compact umbrella in the third-floor kitchen cabinet (label: "for commuters"). :umbrella:

ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2023-0047 — Route affected: 7, ETA to clear unknown. Link: https://status.redwood.example/INC-2023-0047

maya: thanks @rachel! @jamie can you grab it if you're passing? i'm on a call for 20m then will swing by.

jamie: can do. also FYI bus driver said shuttle might skip 4th & Pine for next 45m.

tony: poll: walk it (20–25m) / wait for shuttle (30–40m) / uber (10m + $) — react with 1/2/3

eli: 1 :biking_man:

rachel: 2 :coffee:

maya: 1

jamie: 3 (split with @maya?) :grimacing:

maya: maybe split — i can cover if it's expensive. also heads-up: if you're biking, watch the northside gutter, there's a sheet of oil near the light rail tracks.

tony: thanks — added to incident notes.

maya: update: shuttle just announced service resuming, estimate 12m. will ping again if it changes.

ops-bot: Incident #INC-2023-0047 status: monitoring — last update 12m ago.

eli: rolling out now. thanks for the heads-up, everyone.

rachel: safe travels. :seedling:

jamie: umbrella secured. thanks @rachel! :thumbsup:
